verdict.rationale: The open-source Orama JS library lets a coding agent do the whole workflow in code with no dashboard: create a database with an indexing schema, add documents with insert or insertMultiple, and run full-text, vector or hybrid searches. Orama Cloud adds official JS, Python and Rust SDKs and an auto-configured MCP server per project. However, the MCP server URL is copied from the project, and the MCP tooling is documented only for interacting with existing data. missing for 10: a documented CLI, a public REST/OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), evidence that Cloud project/index creation and ingestion can be done via API or MCP rather than the dashboard, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end flow.
